# Isolated Runbook

This synthetic document belongs to a repository that is never selected in quality queries.
It exists to prove that unselected content cannot leak into another scope.

## Marker

The unique fixture marker is ISOLATED-ONLY-MARKER-7f3a.
The Chinese fixture marker is 隔离仓库专用标记.
If either marker appears in an evidence result for a scope that does not select this repository, isolation has failed.

## Procedure

The isolated procedure rotates a fictional credential named example-isolated-key.
It is never a real credential and must never be copied into another document.

## Containment

The repository has its own index version and its own generation counter.
Selecting a different repository must not include this index version in the vector filter.
A comprehensive query must not broaden the selected scope by name matching.
